bug_info.bug_desc: In the C0 Zcb sub-decoder of core/compressed_decoder.sv, the c.sh branch expands every encoding with instr_i[12:10] == 3'b011 into a 32-bit store-halfword instruction. It does not check the reserved high immediate bit instr_i[6], which the Zcb specification requires to be 0. As a result, a 16-bit c.sh encoding with bit 6 set is treated as a valid compressed instruction and forwarded as sh, instead of being flagged as illegal.
bug_info.fix_hint: In core/compressed_decoder.sv, within the C0/Zcb c.sh branch, add a check that asserts illegal_instr_o when instr_i[6] == 1'b1. The existing final assignment already passes the original compressed word through when illegal_instr_o is set.
